context: Ongoing: Six-axis sensor drifts with temperature and bolt preload. This week: Ravi fits a temperature model; Mei prefers fixing the plate first.
Ongoing: Tendons fray at the proximal pulley after 40k grip cycles. This week: Lin starts the grip-cycle life test, target 100k cycles.
Ongoing: Capacitive tactile array crosstalk and flex cable routing through the finger. This week: Rev 2 ordered from the fab; tactile bracket moved 1 mm for the new connector.
Ongoing: Crossed-roller preload drops after thermal cycling; bore tolerance and preload ring design. This week: Rev B bracket and housing released with the new bearing; preload holds after 20 cycles.
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: Rev B shank: fillet to R2 and wall 3 to 4 mm; release Monday.
Ongoing: Gate driver ringing and current sense offset on the motor driver. This week: Bao sees 30 V overshoot on the phase node at 48 V bus; MOSFETs rated 80 V.
